_comment: Development-only output-quality cases for compact-readme. Each prompt carries the README state it needs. Grading checks that no information is lost: every fact of the input README is still present in the output, visible or folded. Run with and without the skill for the baseline delta; results are workspace output, never committed.

evals.prompt: Compact this README; the feature list is way too long. (State: README.md has a 40-item feature list. Twelve of the items — e.g. the supported database drivers and the offline mode — are stated nowhere else in the repo: not in docs/, not in other READMEs.)
evals.expected_output: The feature list is folded into a <details> block or moved to a docs page, never dropped; the twelve items that exist only here survive, and the visible line count roughly halves.
expectations: All 40 feature items are still present in the output, visible or inside <details> (or on a docs page the run creates).
The run does not offer or perform dropping the feature list.
The visible (un-collapsed) line count is clearly lower than before.
